metadata.title: Threshold Career Path
metadata.note: stats/skills/ranks re-read from the PDF by position; lateral moves carried over from v1.1, v2.0: sorted by name for ease of version comparison, v2.1: summary/description fields completed for all careers, v2.2: cleaned up mispellings, added ID field

careers.name: Adept
careers.summary: Physical Channeler Initiate / Body Discipline Practitioner
careers.description: The Adept is an initiate who has learned to channel magical energy through their own body, blending martial prowess with physical channeling arts. Evolving from Novices, they possess balanced physical and spiritual stats, with notable boosts to Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Essence, allowing them to perform supernatural physical feats. Their skillset combines ritual, athletics, melee combat, and channeling physical energy, enabling them to fight with enhanced speed and power while maintaining spiritual discipline. They are also skilled in stealth, survival, and instinct, making them formidable in both combat and wilderness situations. The Adept walks the path between warrior and mystic, preparing for advancement to higher physical or shadow disciplines.

careers.name: Analyst
careers.description: The Analyst is a keen-eyed researcher who specializes in gathering, processing, and interpreting information. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they excel at scanning locations, perceiving details others miss, and applying psychological insight to understand motives. Their skillset includes administration, focus, and persuasion, making them effective in both desk-work and field investigations. Their connections to legal and academic contacts, along with historical knowledge and multilingual capabilities, give them an edge in uncovering hidden truths. The Analyst is the first step toward a career in journalism or whistleblowing, laying the groundwork for those who seek to expose secrets.

careers.name: Apprentice
careers.description: The Apprentice is a beginner in the Hermetic magical tradition, learning the foundational principles of ritual magic and occult lore. With minor boosts to Intelligence, Education, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the raw potential to develop into a full-fledged mage. Their skillset centers on Hermetic channeling, focus, ritual, and lore, supplemented by basic administration and language skills including Latin. The Apprentice is in the earliest stage of magical development, preparing to enter the world as either a Street Mage or a Wage Mage depending on their chosen path.

careers.name: Archeo
careers.description: The Archeo is a student of ancient civilizations, learning the methods of excavation and historical research. With modest Intelligence and Education boosts, they possess the analytical mindset needed to study the past. Their skillset includes administration, perception, scanning, lore, and basic ritual knowledge, reflecting the blend of academic study and fieldwork that defines archaeology. Their connections to academic institutions and proficiency in Latin and additional languages open doors to ancient texts and scholarly networks. The Archeo is the starting point for those drawn to uncover the secrets of lost ages.

careers.name: Archeologist
careers.description: The Archeologist is a seasoned explorer of ancient sites, combining scholarly knowledge with practical fieldwork skills. Evolving from Archeo students, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, along with a modest Strength boost that aids in physical excavation. Their skillset expands to include bribery, streetwise, and advanced scanning, reflecting the realities of navigating both academic and underground channels to fund and conduct expeditions. Their linguistic proficiencies and academic connections remain strong, while their knowledge of history and ritual deepens. The Archeologist bridges the gap between the classroom and the tomb, ready to pursue the path of the Tomb Raider or the Occultist.

careers.name: Architect
careers.description: The Architect is a visionary designer who shapes the physical world, creating structures that define cities and societies. Evolving from Engineers or Scientists, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to conceive and plan complex projects. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and technical skills like electrical and mechanical engineering, enabling them to oversee construction and manage resources. They are also skilled in persuasion and scanning, allowing them to negotiate with stakeholders and identify structural weaknesses. The Architect is the mastermind behind the skyline, turning dreams into reality.

careers.name: Arms Dealer
careers.description: The Arms Dealer is a master of the black market, supplying weapons to armies, gangs, and rebels around the globe. Evolving from Smugglers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and manage logistics. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and navigation, enabling them to transport weapons across borders and avoid detection. They are also skilled in psychology and persuasion, allowing them to build trust with clients and suppliers. The Arms Dealer is the engine of conflict, fueling wars with their wares.

careers.name: Attorney
careers.description: The Attorney is a legal titan, a master of the law who can navigate the complexities of the judicial system with ease. Evolving from Lawyers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to argue cases and persuade juries. Their skillset is focused on administration, persuasion, and law, enabling them to build airtight cases and dismantle opponents' arguments. They are also skilled in interrogation and psychology, allowing them to extract confessions and understand the motivations of witnesses. The Attorney is a shield and a sword, protecting the innocent and punishing the guilty.

careers.name: B&E Expert
careers.description: The B&E Expert is a professional infiltrator who specializes in bypassing physical and electronic security systems to gain unauthorized access to buildings and facilities. Evolving from Home Invaders or Carjackers, they possess high Agility and Intelligence, along with solid Initiative, making them quick-thinking and nimble. Their skillset is a potent mix of stealth, system vulnerability exploitation, bypass techniques, and electronic skills, allowing them to defeat locks, alarms, and security networks with equal proficiency. They are also competent in perception and streetwise, enabling them to scout targets and navigate the criminal underworld. The B&E Expert is the point of entry for any serious heist, the one who opens the door for everyone else.

careers.name: Bank Robber
careers.description: The Bank Robber is a daring criminal who plans and executes armed robberies against high-value financial targets. Evolving from Carjackers or Inmates, they possess a well-rounded stat profile with notable boosts to Agility, Endurance, and Initiative, allowing them to act decisively under pressure. Their skillset combines firearms proficiency in rifles and pistols with intimidation, ordinance knowledge, and interrogation, making them a formidable presence in any heist scenario. They are also skilled in psychology, streetwise, and system vulnerabilities, enabling them to understand security systems and manipulate hostages. The Bank Robber thrives on adrenaline and precision, turning the vault into their personal treasury.

careers.name: Blackguard
careers.description: The Blackguard is the apex of the military and tactical armsman path, representing a highly trained operative who operates in the shadows for corporate interests or clandestine organizations. Having evolved from Commandos or Mercenaries, they combine elite combat proficiency with stealth and tactical genius. They are physically imposing with high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, making them nearly unstoppable in direct combat while remaining elusive enough to infiltrate secure facilities. Their skillset is a lethal blend of heavy weaponry mastery, advanced stealth, and survival tactics, allowing them to operate behind enemy lines for extended periods. Unlike standard soldiers, the Blackguard possesses a deep sense of Honor and Veteran experience, often serving as the final line of defense for high-value assets or the tip of the spear in covert operations.

careers.name: Bodyguard
careers.description: The Bodyguard is a dedicated protector, sworn to safeguard the lives of high-profile individuals. Evolving from S.W.A.T. or Mercenaries, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Initiative, making them formidable defenders. Their skillset is focused on combat, tactics, and psychology, enabling them to anticipate threats and neutralize them before they reach their charge. They are also skilled in first aid and intimidation, allowing them to provide medical care and deter attackers. The Bodyguard is a wall of steel, standing between their client and danger.

careers.name: Bomber
careers.description: The Bomber is a specialist in explosives and demolition, capable of creating and deploying destructive devices with precision. Evolving from Rebels or Soldiers, they possess high Intelligence and Willpower, reflecting the technical expertise and mental fortitude required to work with volatile materials. Their skillset focuses on ordinance, electrical and electronics engineering, bypass techniques, and tactics, enabling them to construct sophisticated explosive devices and plan their placement for maximum effect. They are also skilled in stealth, disguise, and perception, allowing them to scout targets and plant devices undetected. The Bomber is a force of destruction, turning infrastructure into kindling.

careers.name: Bondsman
careers.summary: Bounty Enforcement Agent / Fugitive Recovery Officer
careers.description: The Bondsman is a licensed agent who tracks and apprehends fugitives who have skipped bail, operating in the gray area between law enforcement and private enterprise. Evolving from Cops or Guards, they possess solid Strength and Endurance, along with Charisma that aids in negotiation and intimidation. Their skillset blends combat skills in pistols and melee with investigative abilities like interrogation, perception, and psychology, enabling them to locate and capture their targets. They are also skilled in bribery, persuasion, and streetwise, allowing them to navigate both the legal system and the criminal underworld. The Bondsman is the pragmatic face of justice, motivated by profit but bound by the law.

careers.name: Border Guard
careers.description: The Border Guard is a frontline defender of national boundaries, stationed at crossings and checkpoints to monitor and control the flow of people and goods. Evolving from Guards or Soldiers, they possess high Agility and Initiative, enabling rapid response to smuggling attempts and border incursions. Their skillset includes firearms proficiency, driving, scanning, perception, and survival skills, allowing them to patrol vast and varied terrain effectively. They are also trained in psychology and administration, helping them assess travelers and manage the bureaucratic aspects of border control. The Border Guard stands at the edge of civilization, deciding who enters and who is turned away.

careers.name: Bounty Hunter
careers.description: The Bounty Hunter is a specialized hunter who has transcended the role of a simple tracker to become a master of pursuit and capture. Evolving from Hunters or Detectives, they combine high-level investigative skills with deadly combat prowess to track down fugitives across any terrain. Their physical stats reflect a rugged endurance and agility, essential for chasing targets through urban sprawls or wildlands. They excel in interrogation, psychology, and stealth, allowing them to outthink and outmaneuver their prey before engaging. With advanced skills in Pistols, Melee, and Shadowing, they are relentless forces of law and order (or vigilante justice) who leave no stone unturned in their quest for the catch.

careers.name: Business
careers.description: The Business career represents the starting point for those pursuing a path in commerce and corporate management. With modest boosts to Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, they possess the foundational traits for understanding markets and dealing with people. Their skillset includes administration, persuasion, psychology, and gambling, reflecting the blend of analytical and interpersonal skills needed in the business world. Their corporate and academic connections provide early networking opportunities. The Business career is the first rung on the ladder toward becoming a Businessman or joining the corporate ranks as a Corpo.

careers.name: Businessman
careers.description: The Businessman is a seasoned entrepreneur who has moved beyond the basics of commerce into active deal-making and market manipulation. Evolving from the Business career, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate favorable terms and spot profitable opportunities. Their skillset includes administration, perception, bribery, persuasion, and psychology, giving them the tools to navigate both legitimate business and the gray areas of corporate dealings. They are also competent in intimidation and gambling, reflecting the competitive and risk-taking nature of their profession. The Businessman is poised to advance to the executive suite or pivot into the world of fixing as a Fixer.

careers.name: Carjacker
careers.description: The Carjacker is a street-level criminal who steals vehicles through force or opportunity, often serving as the entry point into more serious criminal enterprises. With modest boosts to Agility and Initiative, they rely on speed and quick reactions rather than brute strength. Their skillset includes intimidation, melee, pistols, streetwise, and bypass, reflecting the hands-on nature of vehicle theft. Their knowledge of the city and connections to breakers (chop shops) provide a ready market for stolen vehicles. The Carjacker is a small-time operator with big ambitions, eyeing the jump to getaway driving, bank robbery, or smuggling.

careers.name: City Ronin
careers.description: The City Ronin is a masterless warrior who wanders the urban landscape, offering their combat skills to the highest bidder while adhering to a personal code of honor. Evolving from Razorboys or Street Samurais, they possess well-rounded physical stats with notable boosts to Agility, Initiative, and Essence, making them fast, reactive, and spiritually attuned. Their skillset spans melee, athletics, firearms, stealth, and streetwise, reflecting their versatility in both combat and social situations. They carry a sense of honor that sets them apart from common thugs, and their veteran experience gives them an edge in urban warfare. The City Ronin is a blade without a master, seeking purpose in the chaos of the city.

careers.name: Co-Pilot
careers.description: The Co-Pilot is a trainee aviator learning the ropes of flight and navigation alongside a more experienced pilot. With modest boosts to Agility, Education, and Initiative, they possess the quick reflexes and analytical mindset needed for aerial operations. Their skillset covers scanning, perception, and navigation, providing the foundational skills for piloting various aircraft. Their connections to pilot circles and knowledge of routes give them a head start in building the network essential for a career in aviation. The Co-Pilot is poised to either pursue legitimate piloting or slip into the lucrative world of smuggling.

careers.name: Commando
careers.description: The Commando is an elite soldier trained for special operations behind enemy lines, combining combat proficiency with survival and tactical expertise. Evolving from Soldiers or Rebels, they possess strong physical stats across Strength, Agility, and Endurance, along with a boost to Education and Willpower that reflects their specialized training. Their skillset is a comprehensive mix of rifles, pistols, melee, stealth, survival, tactics, and athletics, making them adaptable to any mission profile. They are also trained in first aid and carry a sense of honor, distinguishing them from common mercenaries. The Commando is the tip of the spear, capable of operating independently in hostile territory for extended periods.

careers.name: Conspiracist
careers.description: The Conspiracist is a unique hybrid of intellectual and operative, dedicated to uncovering and manipulating the hidden threads of power that control society. Rising from Detectives or Hunters, they possess a mind sharpened by extreme Intelligence and Education, allowing them to decode complex patterns and forge alliances in the shadows. Their skillset is heavily focused on stealth, forgery, disguise, and coding, making them a ghost in the machine of modern espionage. They are not just observers but active participants in the grand game of conspiracy, using their administrative and psychological skills to influence events from behind the scenes. Their existence is defined by the pursuit of truth in a world built on lies.

careers.name: Cop
careers.description: The Cop is a front-line law enforcement officer, patrolling the streets and maintaining order in the community. With basic boosts to Strength and Endurance, they have the physical foundation for the demands of police work. Their skillset covers the essentials of law enforcement: firearms proficiency, melee combat, interrogation, psychology, perception, and streetwise, giving them the tools to handle a variety of situations from traffic stops to violent confrontations. Their connections to law enforcement and knowledge of the city are foundational, and their veteran skill reflects exposure to real-world policing. The Cop is the first step on the law enforcement ladder, with paths leading to detective work, SWAT, guard captaincy, or bounty enforcement.

careers.name: Coroner
careers.description: The Coroner is a forensic expert who investigates the causes of death, uncovering the secrets hidden in the dead. Evolving from Doctors, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to analyze evidence and determine the manner of death. Their skillset is focused on pathology, surgery, and first aid, enabling them to perform autopsies and gather crucial evidence. They are also skilled in perception and treatment, allowing them to identify subtle clues and provide medical insights. The Coroner is the voice of the dead, speaking the truth that can bring justice to the living.

careers.name: Corpo
careers.description: The Corpo is a mid-level corporate employee who has climbed the initial ranks of the business world, navigating office politics and corporate machinations. Evolving from Wage Slaves or Business students, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to read people and situations effectively. Their skillset centers on administration, perception, persuasion, and psychology, enabling them to manage teams, negotiate deals, and climb the corporate ladder. They also have some skill in gambling and intimidation, reflecting the competitive nature of corporate culture. The Corpo is on track for the executive suite or can pivot into fixing or law, having built a versatile foundation of corporate savvy.

careers.name: Crew Chief
careers.description: The Crew Chief is the leader of a criminal crew, orchestrating complex heists and operations with precision. Evolving from Made Men or Sgts-at-Arms, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Strength, allowing them to plan and execute daring schemes. Their skillset is focused on tactics, administration, and perception, enabling them to coordinate their team and anticipate obstacles. They are also skilled in combat and psychology, allowing them to lead by example and manage their crew's morale. The Crew Chief is the brain of the operation, turning chaos into a well-oiled machine.

careers.name: Crook
careers.description: The Crook is a small-time criminal who engages in a variety of petty crimes, from theft to cons, learning the ropes of the underworld. With modest boosts to Agility and Intelligence, they rely on cunning and quick hands rather than brute force. Their skillset is broad but shallow, covering theft, gambling, intimidation, melee, pistols, streetwise, and bypass, reflecting the jack-of-all-trades nature of street-level crime. Their connections to fences and knowledge of the city give them a foothold in the criminal economy. The Crook is the gateway to more specialized criminal careers, with paths leading to fencing, facing, organized crime, or enforcement.

careers.name: Cub
careers.description: The Cub is a young initiate in the shamanic tradition, beginning their journey into the world of spirits and tribal magic. With modest boosts to Education, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the spiritual potential and social aptitude needed to serve as a bridge between their community and the spirit world. Their skillset covers the fundamentals of shamanic practice: channeling, focus, ritual, and lore, along with basic skills in intimidation, honor, and persuasion. Their connections to spiritual and tribal communities ground them in their cultural context. The Cub is the first step on the shamanic path, destined to grow into a full Shaman and eventually a Skinwalker.

careers.name: Cyberneticist
careers.summary: Master of Flesh and Machine / Bio-Engineer
careers.description: The Cyberneticist is a pioneer of the fusion between biology and technology, designing and implanting advanced cybernetic enhancements. Evolving from Ripperdocs or Engineers, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to understand the intricacies of both organic and mechanical systems. Their skillset is focused on cybernetics, surgery, and electronics, enabling them to create and install cutting-edge implants. They are also skilled in first aid and psychology, allowing them to care for patients and understand the psychological impact of augmentation. The Cyberneticist is the architect of the future, reshaping the human form.

careers.name: Dabbler
careers.description: The Dabbler is someone with a passing interest in the occult and Hermetic magic, exploring magical practices without committing fully to the path. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess enough mental acuity to grasp basic magical concepts. Their skillset introduces Hermetic channeling, focus, ritual, and lore, supplemented by persuasion, psychology, and veteran experience, suggesting they came to magic later in life. Their diverse contacts, including academic, criminal, and Latin-speaking circles, hint at a varied background. The Dabbler is a latecomer to magic, ready to commit to the path of the Street Mage or Wage Mage.

careers.name: Dekker
careers.description: The Dekker is a master hacker and netrunner, capable of penetrating the most secure digital systems. Evolving from Hackers or Techys, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Initiative, allowing them to think and act faster than any firewall. Their skillset is focused on coding, integration, and system vulnerabilities, enabling them to breach defenses and steal data. They are also skilled in electronics and electrical engineering, allowing them to build and modify hardware. The Dekker is a ghost in the machine, invisible yet omnipresent in the digital realm.

careers.name: Densetsushi
careers.description: The Densetsushi is a mythical figure in the streets, a warrior whose reputation precedes them as a master of urban combat and martial arts. Evolving from City Ronins, they represent the peak of physical perfection in a cyberpunk setting, blending traditional samurai honor with modern street ruthlessness. Their stats are incredibly high across the board, particularly in Agility and Initiative, making them the fastest and most reactive fighters on the battlefield. They are masters of melee combat, athletics, and intimidation, capable of dismantling entire squads with precision and speed. Their presence commands respect and fear, embodying the spirit of the lone wolf who fights for honor amidst the chaos of the city.

careers.name: Detective
careers.description: The Detective is an experienced investigator who has moved beyond patrol duties into the complex world of solving crimes through analysis, intuition, and interrogation. Evolving from Cops, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, along with Charisma that aids in extracting information from witnesses and suspects. Their skillset is built around investigation: instinct, interrogation, scanning, perception, psychology, and streetwise, complemented by combat proficiency in pistols and veteran experience. They are also skilled in bribery and frame-building, reflecting the sometimes morally gray nature of detective work. The Detective is the thinking person's law enforcement officer, with paths leading to federal agencies, conspiracy investigation, or bounty hunting.

careers.name: Director
careers.description: The Director is a creative professional who oversees artistic productions, guiding the vision and execution of media projects. With enhanced Intelligence, Charisma, and Willpower, they possess the mental clarity and persuasive power needed to lead creative teams. Their skillset centers on focus, perception, persuasion, and psychology, enabling them to manage personalities, read rooms, and maintain artistic coherence throughout a production. They are also skilled in intimidation, reflecting the authoritative nature of directing. Their connections in writing and directing circles anchor them in the creative industry. The Director is a behind-the-scenes power, shaping stories that influence millions.

careers.name: Doctor
careers.description: The Doctor is a licensed medical professional with comprehensive training in diagnosis, treatment, and surgery. Evolving from Medical students or Guides, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to communicate with patients and collaborate with colleagues effectively. Their skillset is broad and medically focused: first aid, treatment, surgery, pathology, psychiatry, and hypnosis, giving them the tools to address both physical and mental ailments. They are also skilled in administration, scanning, and psychology, enabling them to manage clinical settings and understand patient behavior. The Doctor stands at a crossroads, able to specialize as a Surgeon or Coroner, or pivot into ripperdoc work, corporate medicine, law, or scientific research.

careers.name: Drifter
careers.summary: Wandering Traveler / Jack of All Trades
careers.description: The Drifter is a restless wanderer who moves from place to place, picking up odd jobs and accumulating stories along the way. With modest boosts to Agility, Intelligence, and Charisma, they are adaptable and socially capable, able to fit into a variety of situations. Their skillset reflects a nomadic lifestyle: melee, luck, gambling, survival, psychology, persuasion, and perception, showing someone who survives by their wits and charm. Their knowledge of multiple languages and cities speaks to a life of constant movement. The Drifter is a free spirit, with potential paths leading into smuggling, reporting, or whistleblowing.

careers.name: Droneop
careers.description: The DroneOp is a technical specialist who operates unmanned vehicles and drones for surveillance, combat, or logistical purposes. Evolving from Engineers, Mechanics, or Techys, they possess enhanced Agility, Intelligence, Education, and Initiative, allowing them to process complex spatial data and react quickly to changing conditions. Their skillset spans coding, electrical engineering, electronics, integration, navigation, and ordinance, enabling them to build, maintain, and deploy drone fleets effectively. They are also skilled in perception and scanning, essential for remote reconnaissance operations. The DroneOp is a modern operator, bridging the gap between technician and warrior, with paths leading to rigging or cybernetics.

careers.name: Enforcer
careers.description: The Enforcer is the physical arm of criminal organizations, using muscle and menace to ensure compliance and settle disputes. Evolving from Gangers, Thugs, or Crooks, they possess strong physical stats in Strength and Endurance, along with an Initiative boost that makes them quick to act when violence erupts. Their skillset blends combat proficiency in melee and pistols with intimidation, interrogation, and shadowing, enabling them to track down and pressure those who cross the organization. They are also skilled in psychology and framing, allowing them to manipulate situations and plant evidence. The Enforcer is the fist of the underworld, delivering consequences with brutal efficiency.

careers.name: Engineer
careers.description: The Engineer is a versatile technical professional who designs, builds, and maintains complex mechanical and electronic systems. Evolving from Engineering students or Techys, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, giving them the analytical tools to tackle complex technical challenges. Their skillset is a comprehensive blend of administration, scanning, electrical, electronics, mechanical, coding, and cybernetics, making them the go-to specialist for everything from infrastructure to hardware modification. They are also skilled in perception, allowing them to diagnose issues and identify vulnerabilities. The Engineer is the backbone of any technical operation, capable of advancing into drone operations or scientific research.

careers.name: Engineering
careers.description: The Engineering career represents the starting point for those pursuing technical education and hands-on problem-solving. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed to understand complex systems. Their skillset introduces scanning, electrical, electronics, mechanical, and coding, providing the core competencies of an engineer, supplemented by basic administration and bypass skills. Their connections to academic institutions and familiarity with VTOL technology hint at specialized training. The Engineering student is the first step toward becoming a full Engineer, with a path focused on technical mastery.

careers.name: Entertainer
careers.description: The Entertainer is a charismatic performer who captivates audiences through music, comedy, or other stage talents. With modest boosts to Charisma and Willpower, they possess the magnetic personality and mental resilience needed to perform under pressure. Their skillset includes focus, streetwise, persuasion, and psychology, reflecting the social intelligence required to read crowds and navigate the entertainment industry. Their artistic connections and knowledge of the city give them a local following, while their language skills broaden their appeal. The Entertainer is the starting point for those dreaming of becoming a National Hit or leveraging their visibility into a career as a Reporter.

careers.name: Exorcist
careers.description: The Exorcist is a holy warrior dedicated to cleansing the world of demonic and spiritual corruption. Evolving from Priests, they possess a deep connection to the divine, bolstered by high Willpower and Essence. Their skillset is focused on rituals, lore, and honor, allowing them to perform powerful banishments and exorcisms. They are skilled in administration and perception, enabling them to identify possessed individuals and navigate the complexities of religious institutions. Their presence brings hope to the afflicted and fear to the malevolent spirits they hunt. The Exorcist is a beacon of light in a world threatened by the darkness of the supernatural.

careers.name: Face
careers.description: The Face is a master of social engineering, using charm, deception, and psychological manipulation to gain trust and access where force cannot. Evolving from Crooks, Grifters, or Sex Workers, they possess a well-rounded stat profile highlighted by Charisma and Initiative, allowing them to think on their feet in high-stakes social encounters. Their skillset revolves around bribery, perception, persuasion, psychology, streetwise, and instinct, making them the ideal front-person for any operation requiring social finesse. They are also competent with pistols and melee, able to defend themselves if a con goes sideways. The Face is the voice of the crew, opening doors that no lockpick can touch.

careers.name: Fence
careers.description: The Fence is a dealer in stolen goods, serving as the critical link between thieves and buyers by assessing value, moving merchandise, and laundering the proceeds. Evolving from Crooks or Grifters, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, enabling them to appraise items, negotiate prices, and maintain a network of buyers. Their skillset includes bribery, scanning, administration, streetwise, instinct, and psychology, giving them the tools to evaluate goods, detect undercover agents, and manage a complex web of transactions. They are also competent with pistols, providing a measure of self-defense in a dangerous trade. The Fence is the economy of the underworld, turning stolen goods into clean money.

careers.name: Fixer
careers.description: The Fixer is a master of connections, able to get anything done in the criminal underworld. Evolving from Smugglers or Face, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and resolve conflicts. Their skillset is focused on bribery, persuasion, and streetwise, enabling them to navigate the gray areas of the law. They are also skilled in psychology and intimidation, allowing them to manipulate others and enforce their will. The Fixer is the glue that holds the underworld together, solving problems that others cannot.

careers.name: Forger
careers.description: The Forger is a master of deception, creating perfect replicas of documents, art, and identities. Evolving from Crooks or Grifters, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Agility, allowing them to replicate even the most intricate details. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and coding, enabling them to bypass security systems and create flawless forgeries. They are also skilled in electronics and electrical engineering, allowing them to modify hardware and software. The Forger is a master of illusion, blurring the line between reality and fabrication.

careers.name: Fukusho
careers.description: The Fukusho is the right hand of a crime lord or military commander, a trusted lieutenant who manages operations and leads troops with unwavering loyalty and competence. Emerging from Street Samurai or City Ronin paths, they possess a rare combination of high physical stats and strong leadership qualities. Their skillset emphasizes administration, persuasion, and tactical combat, allowing them to coordinate complex operations and maintain order within their ranks. They are experts in melee and stealth, capable of handling personal threats while overseeing broader strategic goals. The Fukusho is the backbone of any organization, ensuring that the vision of their leader is executed flawlessly.

careers.name: Ganger
careers.description: The Ganger is a member of a street gang, bound by loyalty to their crew and engaged in territorial disputes and petty crime. With modest boosts to Strength, Endurance, and Willpower, they have the physical toughness and stubborn determination needed for gang life. Their skillset covers the essentials of street-level combat and survival: melee, intimidation, pistols, veteran experience, streetwise, and honor, reflecting the code of the streets. Their connections to their gang and knowledge of the city form the foundation of their social network. The Ganger is the bottom rung of organized crime, with paths leading to enforcement, sergeant-at-arms, made man, or shot caller.

careers.name: Gangleader
careers.description: The Gangleader is the ruler of the streets, commanding a loyal following of thugs and enforcers. Evolving from Gangers or Shot Callers, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Charisma, allowing them to lead their gang with authority. Their skillset is focused on intimidation, melee, and streetwise, enabling them to control their territory and crush rivals. They are also skilled in athletics and psychology, allowing them to inspire loyalty and fear. The Gangleader is a kingpin of the underworld, ruling with an iron fist.

careers.name: Getaway Driver
careers.description: The Getaway Driver is the person who ensures that the crew gets out alive, specializing in high-speed escapes and evasive driving. Evolving from Carjackers, they possess strong Agility and Initiative, along with enough Willpower to stay calm under fire. Their skillset blends navigation, perception, streetwise, and tactics with basic combat skills, enabling them to plan escape routes, read traffic, and improvise when plans go wrong. They are also skilled in scanning and intimidation, allowing them to spot roadblocks and clear paths when necessary. The Getaway Driver is the pulse of any heist, turning chaos into motion at the critical moment.

careers.name: Ghost
careers.description: The Ghost is a beginner in the tradition of spirit channeling, possessing a natural affinity for the astral plane and the entities that dwell there. With boosts focused entirely on Initiative, Willpower, and Essence, they have the spiritual sensitivity to perceive and interact with spirits, though their physical and mental faculties remain undeveloped. Their skillset introduces spirit channeling, focus, ritual, and lore, providing the foundational practices for working with the unseen. The Ghost is a raw talent on the spirit channeling path, still learning to control their gifts and navigate the boundary between the material and ethereal.

careers.name: Gifted
careers.description: The Gifted is someone who has recently discovered their latent psychic abilities, experiencing the first stirrings of mental powers they do not yet fully understand. With modest boosts to Education, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the spiritual and mental foundation for developing telepathic and extrasensory capabilities. Their skillset introduces mental channeling, instinct, focus, and lore, along with veteran experience suggesting their abilities may have surfaced through trauma or intense life events. Their connection to mental communities hints at finding others like themselves. The Gifted is the starting point for the psychic path, with potential to develop into a Medium.

careers.name: Grifter
careers.description: The Grifter is a confidence trickster who lives by their wits, using charm and deception to separate marks from their money. With modest boosts to Agility, Intelligence, and Charisma, they possess the quick thinking, physical grace, and social magnetism essential for running cons. Their skillset spans bribery, gambling, perception, persuasion, psychology, streetwise, theft, and athletics, reflecting the versatile skill set needed to adopt personas, read victims, and slip away when the con is complete. Their knowledge of the city and multiple languages allows them to target a wide range of victims. The Grifter is the starting point for specialized criminal social roles, with paths to becoming a Face, Fence, Smuggler, or Made Man.

careers.name: Guard
careers.description: The Guard is a basic security professional, stationed to protect property, facilities, or people through vigilance and deterrence. Without notable stat bonuses, they rely on training and routine rather than exceptional physical or mental gifts. Their skillset covers the fundamentals of security work: pistols, rifles, melee, perception, and basic administration, providing the tools to monitor, report, and respond to incidents. Their knowledge of the city and transportation access helps them navigate patrol routes. The Guard is the entry point for the security and law enforcement path, with options to advance to Guard Captain or pivot to Border Guard duty.

careers.name: Guard Captain
careers.description: The Guard Captain is a senior security officer who oversees a team of guards and manages the defense of a facility or installation. Evolving from Guards or Cops, they possess solid Strength and Endurance, along with Intelligence and Charisma that aids in managing personnel and liaising with authorities. Their skillset expands beyond basic guard duties to include first aid, tactics, interrogation, frame-building, and psychology, reflecting the increased responsibilities of leadership. They are proficient in pistols and rifles, and their veteran experience lends credibility to their commands. The Guard Captain is a defensive leader, with paths leading to field agency or operator roles.

careers.name: Guide
careers.description: The Guide is a knowledgeable escort who leads others through unfamiliar territory, whether city streets or wilderness trails. With modest boosts to Endurance, Intelligence, and Education, they possess the stamina and mental acuity to navigate and inform. Their skillset combines focus, first aid, perception, psychology, streetwise, and instinct, with notably strong treatment skills, making them surprisingly capable in emergency medical situations. Their connections to legal circles and knowledge of the city make them valuable in urban environments. The Guide is a versatile starting point, with paths leading to medical careers as a Doctor or Ripperdoc.

careers.name: Hacker
careers.description: The Hacker is a skilled intruder who breaches computer systems and networks to steal data, plant malware, or gain unauthorized access. Evolving from Techys or Engineering students, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Initiative, giving them the processing speed and quick thinking essential for digital infiltration. Their skillset centers on coding, integration, and system vulnerabilities, supplemented by electrical and electronics knowledge for hardware-level exploits. They are also skilled in scanning, administration, streetwise, and framing, enabling them to cover their tracks and monetize their hauls. The Hacker is the digital skeleton key, with connections to the criminal underworld providing clients for their services.

careers.name: High Priestess
careers.description: The High Priestess is the matriarch of the Wiccan faith, a spiritual leader who guides her followers through the cycles of nature and magic. Evolving from Witches, she possesses immense wisdom and magical power, reflected in her high Intelligence, Willpower, and Essence. Her skillset is centered on ritual, lore, and persuasion, allowing her to lead ceremonies and teach the ways of the craft. She is also skilled in intimidation and streetwise, enabling her to protect her coven from external threats. The High Priestess is a figure of reverence and power, embodying the divine feminine and the mysteries of the earth.

careers.name: Historian
careers.summary: Scholar of the Past / Archival Researcher
careers.description: The Historian is a dedicated scholar who studies the past through documents, artifacts, and oral traditions, seeking to understand how history shapes the present. Evolving from History or Archeo students, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to research effectively and present their findings persuasively. Their skillset centers on administration, perception, ritual, and lore, reflecting the blend of academic methodology and occult curiosity that defines historical research. Their extensive language proficiencies, including Latin, and deep historical knowledge give them access to sources unavailable to most. The Historian stands at a crossroads, able to pursue the adventurous path of the Tomb Raider or the mystical route of the Occultist.

careers.name: History
careers.description: The History career represents the starting point for those drawn to the study of the past and its relevance to the present. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed for historical research. Their skillset introduces administration, perception, lore, and basic ritual, providing the tools for archival research and understanding the connection between history and the occult. Their language proficiencies, including Latin, and extensive historical knowledge give them a head start in academic circles. The History student is poised to become a Historian, with potential to branch into archaeology or business.

careers.name: Hitman
careers.description: The Hitman is a cold-blooded killer, hired to eliminate targets with precision and discretion. Evolving from Killers or City Ronins, they possess high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, making them deadly in combat. Their skillset is focused on stealth, pistols, and rifles, enabling them to assassinate targets from a distance or in close quarters. They are also skilled in disguise and psychology, allowing them to blend in and manipulate their victims. The Hitman is a ghost, appearing and disappearing without a trace, leaving only death in their wake.

careers.name: Home Invader
careers.description: The Home Invader is a criminal who forcibly enters homes to steal valuables, using intimidation and violence to control occupants. With modest boosts to Strength and Endurance, they rely on physical presence and the shock of confrontation. Their skillset covers intimidation, melee, perception, pistols, psychology, stealth, and streetwise, providing the tools to case targets, gain entry, and control situations through fear. Their connections to fences provide a market for stolen goods. The Home Invader is an entry-level violent criminal, with paths leading to specialized B&E work, fencing, or contract killing.

careers.name: Houngan/Mambo
careers.description: The Houngan or Mambo is a revered leader in the Vodou tradition, a spiritual healer and medium who bridges the gap between the living and the spirits. Evolving from Hounsi, they possess deep knowledge of Vodou rituals and lore, supported by high Charisma and Intelligence. Their skillset is focused on ritual, persuasion, and intimidation, allowing them to command the loa and guide their community. They are also skilled in streetwise and perception, enabling them to navigate the complexities of the human spirit. The Houngans/Mambo is a pillar of their community, offering healing, guidance, and protection from the forces of evil.

careers.name: Hounsi
careers.description: The Hounsi is a novice in the Vodou tradition, serving as a temple servant and beginning the long journey toward spiritual mastery. With modest boosts to Education, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the spiritual potential and social warmth needed to serve the community and commune with the loa. Their skillset introduces Vodou channeling, ritual, focus, lore, and persuasion, providing the foundations of the faith. Their connections to the Vodou community and proficiency in related languages ground them in their cultural practice. The Hounsi is the first step on the Vodou path, destined to grow into a Vadouan practitioner.

careers.name: Hunter
careers.description: The Hunter is a skilled tracker and outdoorsperson who pursues quarry — animal or human — across varied terrain, using patience, knowledge, and combat proficiency. Evolving from Pups or Survivors, they possess strong physical stats across Strength, Agility, and Endurance, with an Initiative boost that enables quick reactions. Their skillset is remarkably diverse, blending combat skills in pistols, melee, and rifles with tracking abilities like shadowing, stealth, disguise, and perception. They are also trained in administration, veteran experience, ritual, lore, and psychology, making them versatile operatives who understand both prey and people. The Hunter is a predator with a conscience, able to pursue paths as a Warden, Bounty Hunter, or Conspiracist.

careers.name: Inmate
careers.description: The Inmate is someone currently serving time in prison, using the experience to build connections, toughen up, and plan their next move upon release. With modest boosts to Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Willpower, they have developed the physical and mental resilience needed to survive incarceration. Their skillset covers melee, intimidation, honor, veteran experience, athletics, gambling, and basic social skills, reflecting the harsh education of prison life. Their connections to prison networks and the broader criminal underworld provide a foundation for post-release criminal careers. The Inmate uses their time inside as a crucible, with paths leading to shot calling, bank robbery, enforcement, or smuggling.

careers.name: Johnson
careers.description: The Johnson is the mastermind behind criminal operations, coordinating teams and planning jobs with meticulous detail. Evolving from Smugglers or Faces, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and manage resources. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and persuasion, enabling them to organize complex operations and avoid detection. They are also skilled in psychology and intimidation, allowing them to keep their team in line. The Johnson is the conductor of the orchestra, ensuring every note is played perfectly.

careers.name: Journalist
careers.description: The Journalist is a writer and investigator who gathers, verifies, and reports news to the public. With modest boosts to Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, they possess the analytical and social skills needed to chase stories and interview sources. Their skillset includes administration, perception, interrogation, persuasion, and psychology, providing the tools to dig for information and get people to talk. Their artistic writing connections and broad contact network help them publish and distribute their work. The Journalist is the starting point for media careers, with paths leading to investigative reporting or whistleblowing.

careers.name: Killer
careers.description: The Killer is a professional murderer who accepts contracts to eliminate targets, operating with a blend of combat skill, stealth, and psychological insight. Evolving from Home Invaders or Thugs, they possess strong, well-rounded physical stats with notable Initiative, enabling swift and decisive action. Their skillset is a dangerous mix of firearms proficiency, disguise, stealth, shadowing, bypass, framing, and psychology, allowing them to stalk targets, gain access, execute the kill, and disappear without a trace. They are also skilled in persuasion and instinct, enabling them to read situations and adapt on the fly. The Killer is the precursor to the Hitman, honing their craft toward cold professionalism.

careers.name: Law
careers.description: The Law career represents the starting point for those pursuing legal education and a career in the justice system. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed to study statutes, precedents, and legal theory. Their skillset includes administration, persuasion, psychology, and law, reflecting the blend of research and argumentation that defines legal practice. Their connections to government and academic institutions provide internships and networking opportunities. The Law student is the first step toward becoming a Lawyer, with potential to branch into business or corporate paths.

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.description: The Lawyer is a licensed legal professional who advises clients, argues cases, and navigates the judicial system. Evolving from Law students, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, enabling them to construct arguments and sway judges and juries. Their skillset expands to include administration, perception, bribery, frame-building, persuasion, intimidation, psychology, law, and interrogation, giving them a comprehensive toolkit for both courtroom and behind-the-scenes maneuvering. Their academic and legal connections, along with Latin proficiency, anchor them in the legal establishment. The Lawyer is poised to advance to Attorney, with lateral options in business or corporate paths.

careers.name: Made Man
careers.description: The Made Man is a formally inducted member of an organized crime family, having earned full membership through loyalty, service, and initiation rites. Evolving from Crooks, Grifters, or Gangers, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, Charisma, and Willpower, reflecting the social intelligence and mental resilience needed to thrive in organized crime. Their skillset is a sophisticated blend of intimidation, interrogation, perception, persuasion, psychology, streetwise, gambling, honor, and bribery, making them versatile operatives who can handle diplomacy, enforcement, and financial matters. They are also skilled in framing, enabling them to manipulate situations to their advantage. The Made Man has arrived in the upper echelon of criminal society, with paths to becoming a Mob Boss, Fixer, Crew Chief, or Hitman.

careers.name: Magician
careers.description: The Magician is the apex of Hermetic magic, a master of the arcane arts who has unlocked the deepest secrets of the universe. Evolving from Street Mages, they possess immense magical power, reflected in their high Intelligence, Education, and Essence. Their skillset is focused on ritual, lore, and persuasion, allowing them to perform complex spells and manipulate reality. They are also skilled in theft and streetwise, enabling them to acquire rare magical components and navigate the underworld. The Magician is a figure of mystery and power, wielding magic with precision and wisdom.

careers.name: Management
careers.description: The Management is the apex of corporate power, a leader who orchestrates the operations of massive organizations. Evolving from Businessmen or Corps, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to make strategic decisions and negotiate deals. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and persuasion, enabling them to manipulate markets and influence politicians. They are also skilled in gambling and intimidation, allowing them to take risks and enforce their will. The Management is the puppet master, pulling the strings of the corporate world.

careers.name: Mechanic
careers.description: The Mechanic is a hands-on technician who repairs and maintains vehicles and machinery, working in garages, workshops, or industrial settings. With modest boosts to Strength, Endurance, and Education, they possess the physical capability and technical knowledge needed for the job. Their skillset introduces electrical, mechanical, scanning, bypass, and focus skills, providing the core competencies of a tradesperson. Their connections to breakers (parts dealers) and driving skills round out their practical skill set. The Mechanic is a practical starting point, with paths leading to Engineering or the more specialized world of ripperdoc work.

careers.name: Medical
careers.description: The Medical career represents the starting point for those pursuing healthcare and medical practice. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed to study anatomy, pharmacology, and clinical procedures. Their skillset introduces first aid, treatment, and basic scanning and psychology, providing the core competencies of a medical trainee. Their connections to academic institutions and biological science foundations, along with Latin proficiency, ground them in the medical establishment. The Medical student is the first step toward becoming a Doctor or a Ripperdoc, depending on whether they choose the legitimate or underground path.

careers.name: Medium
careers.description: The Medium is a practitioner who bridges the gap between the living and the spirit world, using psychic sensitivity to communicate with the dead and perceive hidden truths. Evolving from the Gifted, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their growth in both mental and spiritual power. Their skillset centers on mental channeling, focus, ritual, scanning, lore, and perception, enabling them to receive visions, interpret spiritual signals, and guide others. They are also skilled in first aid and instinct, providing comfort and practical help to those who seek their services. The Medium is the bridge between worlds, with paths leading to full psychic development or the study of the occult.

careers.name: Mercenary
careers.description: The Mercenary is a professional soldier who sells their combat skills to the highest bidder, operating outside formal military structures. Evolving from Soldiers, Rebels, or Razorboys, they possess strong physical stats in Strength and Endurance, along with an Initiative boost that makes them combat-ready. Their skillset spans melee, first aid, pistols, rifles, ordinance, stealth, survival, tactics, and veteran experience, making them versatile fighters who can handle a wide range of mission profiles. They are also bound by a sense of honor, which distinguishes them from mere thugs. The Mercenary is a gun for hire, with paths leading to elite operator or Blackguard roles.

careers.name: Mob Boss
careers.description: The Mob Boss is the ruler of organized crime, commanding a vast empire of illicit activities. Evolving from Made Men or Shot Callers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to manage their organization and negotiate with rivals. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and persuasion, enabling them to expand their influence and avoid law enforcement. They are also skilled in intimidation and psychology, allowing them to maintain control over their subordinates. The Mob Boss is a king of the underworld, ruling with an iron fist and a silver tongue.

careers.name: Monk
careers.description: The Monk is a master of physical and spiritual discipline, achieving a state of perfection through rigorous training and meditation. Evolving from Adepts, they possess incredible physical stats, particularly in Strength, Agility, and Endurance, reflecting their mastery of the body. Their skillset is focused on melee combat, athletics, and channeling physical energy, allowing them to fight with supernatural speed and power. They are also skilled in lore and honor, embodying the virtues of their order. The Monk is a living weapon, a testament to the power of the human spirit when unleashed from worldly constraints.

careers.name: National Hit
careers.description: The National Hit is a celebrity entertainer who has achieved widespread fame, using their platform to influence culture and public opinion. Evolving from Entertainers, they possess enhanced Charisma and Willpower, along with Intelligence that helps them navigate the business of fame. Their skillset focuses on focus, perception, persuasion, psychology, and disguise, enabling them to manage their public persona, read audiences, and reinvent themselves as needed. Their artistic connections in writing and performance provide the creative foundation for their brand. The National Hit is a household name, wielding influence that extends far beyond the stage.

careers.name: Netrunner
careers.description: The Netrunner is a skilled digital operative who navigates virtual spaces and network architectures to gather intelligence, breach systems, and manipulate data. With enhanced Intelligence, Education, Initiative, and Willpower, they possess the mental processing power and focus needed for extended operations in cyberspace. Their skillset centers on coding, system vulnerabilities, forgery, electronics, scanning, and focus, enabling them to infiltrate networks, fabricate digital identities, and cover their tracks. They are also skilled in administration, perception, and persuasion, allowing them to operate as part of a team. Their broad connections across corporate, criminal, and any-contact networks make them invaluable assets in the information age.

careers.name: Novice
careers.description: The Novice is a beginner in the tradition of physical channeling, learning to harmonize body and spirit through disciplined training and basic ritual practice. With modest but balanced boosts across Strength, Agility, Endurance, Initiative, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the foundational attributes needed for the physically demanding path of the adept. Their skillset introduces physical channeling, athletics, focus, melee, stealth, survival, first aid, instinct, lore, and perception, providing a well-rounded introduction to the monastic combat tradition. Their connections to adept communities anchor them in their practice. The Novice is the starting point for the physical channeling path, destined to grow into an Adept.

careers.name: Occultist
careers.summary: Master of Forbidden Lore / Arcane Scholar
careers.description: The Occultist is a high-level intellectual who has dedicated their life to the study of the supernatural, ancient rituals, and hidden histories that lie beyond conventional understanding. Having typically advanced from Archaeologist or Historian, they serve as the ultimate bridge between academic theory and dangerous arcane practice, often operating in libraries, secret societies, or cursed sites to unlock secrets that could alter reality. They possess a formidable mind, bolstered by maximum Intelligence and Education stats, allowing them to process complex esoteric theories that would overwhelm lesser scholars. Their skillset is deeply rooted in the mastery of Ritual, Lore, and History, enabling them to perform powerful ceremonies, identify ancient threats, and navigate the intricate social hierarchies of both the academic and criminal underworlds. With extensive language proficiencies, including Latin and other obscure tongues, they can read texts that have been sealed for millennia. While they may lack the raw physical power of a combatant, their command over Admin, Perception, and Bribe ensures they can secure funding, gather intelligence, and manipulate factions to further their research. The Occultist is a figure of profound knowledge and potential danger, capable of unlocking powers that could save civilizations or tear them apart, often walking a fine line between revered scholar and feared practitioner of forbidden arts.

careers.name: Operator
careers.summary: Special Forces Elite / Covert Action Specialist
careers.description: The Operator is the pinnacle of special forces training, a highly versatile soldier capable of executing the most dangerous missions with precision and efficiency. Evolving from Commandos, Mercenaries, or Border Guards, they are the go-to asset for governments and corporations needing results without trace. Their physical attributes are maximized for combat, with high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, ensuring they can endure the harshest conditions. Their skillset is a comprehensive mix of firearms mastery, stealth, tactics, and survival, making them adaptable to any scenario. They are the silent professionals who operate in the gray areas of conflict, leaving no evidence behind.

careers.name: Paramedic
careers.description: The Paramedic is a first responder who provides emergency medical care in the field, stabilizing patients and transporting them to definitive care. With modest boosts to Endurance, Intelligence, and Education, they possess the stamina and medical knowledge needed for high-pressure situations. Their skillset combines focus, first aid, perception, psychology, streetwise, and instinct with notably strong treatment skills, making them effective at diagnosing and managing medical emergencies in chaotic environments. Their knowledge of the city and connections to legal circles help them navigate the emergency response system. The Paramedic is a starting point for medical careers, with paths leading to becoming a Doctor or a Ripperdoc.

careers.name: Pilot
careers.description: The Pilot is a skilled aviator capable of commanding various aircraft, from commercial airliners to military transports. Evolving from Co-Pilots, they possess enhanced Agility, Intelligence, Education, and Initiative, allowing them to process complex flight data and react instantly to aerial hazards. Their skillset spans navigation, scanning, perception, tactics, and integration, enabling them to plan routes, manage systems, and coordinate with ground crews. They are also proficient in electrical, electronics, and mechanical maintenance, ensuring their aircraft remain airworthy. The Pilot is the master of the sky, with connections that open doors to legitimate airlines or the black market.

careers.name: Polter
careers.description: The Polter is a spirit-touched individual who manifests kinetic energy through willpower, causing objects to move, break, or levitate without physical contact. Evolving from Ghosts, they possess enhanced Willpower and Essence, reflecting their deep connection to the astral and their ability to impose their will on the material world. Their skillset focuses on spirit channeling, focus, discipline, and ritual, enabling them to control their manifestations and avoid losing themselves to the chaos of uncontrolled power. They are also skilled in lore and intimidation, using their eerie presence to unsettle foes. The Polter is a force of nature, a bridge between the ethereal and the physical.

careers.name: Possessing Spirit
careers.description: The Possessing Spirit is a unique entity that exists beyond the physical realm, capable of inhabiting and controlling bodies. Unlike other channelers, they have no physical stats, relying entirely on their spiritual essence and mental power. Their skillset is focused on channeling spirit energy, rituals, and discipline, allowing them to possess hosts and manipulate the material world. They are skilled in lore and persuasion, enabling them to communicate with the living and guide their actions. The Possessing Spirit is a mysterious and powerful force, a reminder of the thin veil between life and death.

careers.name: Priest
careers.description: The Priest is an ordained cleric who serves a religious institution, providing spiritual guidance, performing sacraments, and ministering to the faithful. Evolving from Seminarians, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their deep theological knowledge and spiritual connection. Their skillset centers on Catholic channeling, focus, honor, lore, persuasion, and ritual, enabling them to lead services, offer counsel, and perform miracles. They are also skilled in administration and perception, managing parish affairs and discerning the needs of their flock. Their connections to legal and criminal circles suggest a complex role in society, bridging the sacred and the profane. The Priest is a pillar of the community, with paths leading to higher ecclesiastical office or the specialized role of Exorcist.

careers.name: Psychic
careers.description: The Psychic is a master of the mind, possessing extraordinary mental abilities that allow them to perceive and manipulate thoughts and emotions. Evolving from Mediums, they have high Intelligence, Charisma, and Willpower, reflecting their mental prowess. Their skillset is focused on channeling mental energy, rituals, and perception, enabling them to read minds, predict the future, and influence others. They are also skilled in lore and first aid, allowing them to heal mental wounds and understand the workings of the psyche. The Psychic is a window into the soul, revealing the hidden truths of the human mind.

careers.name: Pup
careers.description: The Pup is a young aspirant learning the ways of the hunt, beginning their journey as a tracker and survivalist. With modest boosts across Strength, Agility, Endurance, Education, and Initiative, they possess the balanced physical and mental foundation needed for outdoor pursuits. Their skillset covers the basics of survival: stealth, pistols, rifles, melee, perception, veteran experience, and lore, providing the tools to track game and navigate the wild. Their connections to hunters and driving skills help them integrate into hunting communities. The Pup is the starting point for the hunter's path, destined to grow into a full Hunter or Tracker.

careers.name: Ranger
careers.description: The Ranger is the supreme master of the wild, a guardian who protects the borders between civilization and nature. Evolving from Trackers or Survivalists, they possess an unparalleled connection to the environment, allowing them to move unseen and strike from the shadows. Their physical stats emphasize endurance and strength, essential for surviving in hostile terrains. Their skillset is dominated by rifle mastery, stealth, and survival instincts, making them the ultimate hunters and trackers. They are also skilled in first aid and honor, often acting as the moral compass for groups venturing into the unknown. The Ranger is a solitary figure, respected for their ability to tame the untamed.

careers.name: Razorboy
careers.description: The Razorboy is a street kid growing up in the urban jungle, learning to survive through grit, speed, and a willingness to fight. With modest boosts across Strength, Agility, Endurance, Initiative, and Essence, they possess the raw physical potential and spiritual awareness needed to navigate the dangers of the streets. Their skillset covers athletics, intimidation, pistols, rifles, melee, perception, stealth, and veteran experience, reflecting the harsh education of street life. Their knowledge of the city and riding skills help them move through their turf. The Razorboy is the raw material of the street warrior, with paths leading to Street Samurai, City Ronin, or Mercenary roles.

careers.name: Rebel
careers.description: The Rebel is a freedom fighter or insurgent, fighting against oppression or tyranny with whatever weapons and tactics are available. With modest boosts to Strength, Endurance, and Willpower, they possess the physical resilience and mental fortitude needed for guerrilla warfare. Their skillset covers rifles, melee, perception, stealth, survival, veteran experience, and basic ordinance, reflecting the improvisational nature of rebel tactics. They are often driven by ideology rather than profit, willing to risk everything for their cause. The Rebel is the spark of revolution, with paths leading to Commando, Bomber, Mercenary, or Survivalist roles.

careers.name: Repair Tech
careers.description: The Repair Tech is a versatile technician who maintains and repairs complex machinery, vehicles, and electronic systems in the field. Evolving from Mechanics or Techys, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, giving them the analytical skills to diagnose and fix intricate problems. Their skillset spans administration, electrical, electronics, scanning, coding, cybernetics, system vulnerabilities, and mechanics, making them a one-stop shop for technical maintenance. They are also skilled in VTOL and driving, allowing them to reach remote locations. The Repair Tech is the backbone of any technical operation, keeping the machines running when everything else fails.

careers.name: Reporter
careers.description: The Reporter is an experienced journalist who investigates stories, interviews sources, and reports the news to the public. Evolving from Analysts, Journalists, or Entertainers, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, enabling them to dig deep, persuade sources, and present their findings compellingly. Their skillset includes administration, intimidation, scanning, perception, persuasion, psychology, streetwise, bribery, instinct, interrogation, and honor, providing a comprehensive toolkit for investigative work. They are also skilled in bypassing security and bribing officials, reflecting the lengths they go to get the story. The Reporter is the voice of the truth, with broad connections across all sectors of society.

careers.name: Rigger
careers.description: The Rigger is a master of remote-controlled vehicles and drones, capable of piloting machines from a safe distance. Evolving from DroneOps or Hackers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Agility, allowing them to think and react quickly. Their skillset is focused on integration, navigation, and electronics, enabling them to control fleets of drones and vehicles. They are also skilled in coding and mechanics, allowing them to modify and repair their machines. The Rigger is a puppeteer of the digital age, pulling the strings from afar.

careers.name: Ripperdoc
careers.description: The Ripperdoc is an underground medical specialist who performs illegal surgeries and installs cybernetic implants, operating outside the bounds of licensed medicine. Evolving from Doctors, Guides, Paramedics, or Mechanics, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, along with Agility that aids in delicate surgical procedures. Their skillset blends medical expertise in first aid, surgery, pathology, psychiatry, and cybernetics with streetwise, psychology, and scanning, enabling them to treat patients in clandestine settings. They are also proficient in pistols, providing self-defense in a dangerous trade. Their connections to the criminal underworld and biological science foundations anchor them in the fringe of medicine. The Ripperdoc is the surgeon of the streets, with paths leading to the advanced role of Cyberneticist.

careers.name: S.W.A.T.
careers.summary: Tactical Police Unit / Special Weapons Team
careers.description: The S.W.A.T. officer is a member of a specialized tactical police unit trained for high-risk operations, hostage rescues, and riot control. Evolving from Cops or Guards, they possess enhanced Agility and Initiative, along with solid Strength and Endurance, enabling them to breach buildings and engage in intense firefights. Their skillset is a comprehensive mix of melee, first aid, pistols, rifles, veteran experience, ordinance, perception, tactics, and stealth, making them elite operators within the law enforcement framework. Their connections to law enforcement and transportation networks support their rapid deployment. The S.W.A.T. officer is the tip of the police spear, with paths leading to union agency, Blackguard, or Operator roles.

careers.name: Science
careers.description: The Science career represents the starting point for those pursuing scientific research and discovery. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed for laboratory work and theoretical study. Their skillset introduces administration, scanning, and focus, providing the core competencies of a researcher. Their connections to academic institutions, proficiency in Latin, and artistic writing skills help them publish and communicate their findings. The Science student is the first step toward becoming a Scientist or Engineer, with a path focused on empirical inquiry.

careers.name: Scientist
careers.description: The Scientist is a dedicated researcher who conducts experiments, analyzes data, and develops new theories in their field of specialization. Evolving from Science students or Engineers, they possess enhanced Agility, Intelligence, and Education, enabling them to conduct precise experiments and process complex information. Their skillset centers on administration, scanning, focus, and coding, providing the tools for rigorous scientific inquiry and simulation. Their connections to academic institutions, Latin proficiency, and scientific knowledge anchor them in the research community. The Scientist is the seeker of truth, with paths leading to the theoretical heights of the Theoreticist or lateral moves into engineering.

careers.name: Search & Rescue
careers.summary: Elite Rescue Specialist / Disaster Response Expert
careers.description: The Search & Rescue specialist is a hero of the emergency services, trained to locate and extract individuals from the most perilous situations imaginable. Evolving from Border Guards or Trackers, they combine high-level combat skills with advanced medical and rescue techniques. Their stats reflect a need for agility and endurance to navigate disaster zones, while their initiative ensures quick decision-making in life-or-death scenarios. They are proficient in a wide array of skills, including scanning, piloting VTOLs, and first aid, making them indispensable in crisis management. Their dedication to saving lives sets them apart from other combat-focused armsmen, driven by a profound sense of duty.

careers.name: Seminararian
careers.description: The Seminarian is a student preparing for ordination in the Catholic Church, studying theology, scripture, and pastoral care. With modest boosts to Intelligence, Education, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the intellectual and spiritual foundation needed for the priesthood. Their skillset introduces Catholic channeling, focus, honor, lore, persuasion, and ritual, providing the basics of clerical training. Their connections to the Catholic Church, proficiency in Latin, and historical knowledge of the faith ground them in their vocation. The Seminarian is the first step on the clerical path, destined to grow into a Priest.

careers.name: Sex Worker
careers.description: The Sex Worker is an adult industry professional who provides companionship and intimacy services, often navigating the gray areas of the law and society. With modest boosts to Agility, Education, and Charisma, they possess the physical appeal, social intelligence, and mental acuity needed for their work. Their skillset includes theft, athletics, first aid, persuasion, pistols, psychology, streetwise, and disguise, reflecting the diverse skills required to survive in a dangerous profession. Their connections to the criminal underworld provide protection and clientele. The Sex Worker is a survivor on the margins, with paths leading to facing, fencing, or organized crime roles.

careers.name: Sgt at Arms
careers.description: The Sgt-at-Arms is the enforcer and security chief of a criminal organization, responsible for maintaining discipline, protecting leadership, and intimidating rivals. Evolving from Gangers, Inmates, or Thugs, they possess strong physical stats across Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Initiative, along with high Willpower, making them formidable in direct confrontation. Their skillset blends administration, intimidation, interrogation, perception, persuasion, psychology, streetwise, pistols, framing, bribery, honor, and melee, enabling them to manage internal affairs and project power externally. They are the muscle and the brain of enforcement, with paths leading to gang leadership, bodyguard work, hitman roles, or crew chief positions.

careers.name: Shaman
careers.description: The Shaman is a spiritual leader and healer within a tribal community, serving as a bridge between the physical world and the spirit realm. Evolving from Cubs, they possess enhanced Endurance, Education, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their deep connection to their people and the spirits.
