Their skillset centers on shamanic channeling, focus, intimidation, honor, persuasion, psychology, perception, streetwise, and ritual, enabling them to heal the sick, divine the future, and protect their tribe. Their connections to shamanic, criminal, legal, and channeling communities give them a wide network. The Shaman is the heart of their tribe, with no further paths as they have reached the peak of their tradition.

careers.name: Shot Caller
careers.description: The Shot Caller is a mid-level leader in a criminal organization, responsible for managing operations, settling disputes, and directing lower-level members. Evolving from Gangers or Inmates, they possess strong physical stats across Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Initiative, along with high Willpower, enabling them to lead by example and enforce their authority. Their skillset blends administration, intimidation, interrogation, perception, honor, psychology, gambling, instinct, melee, theft, and bribery, providing the tools to manage a crew and negotiate with rivals. Their connections to the criminal underworld and language skills help them build alliances. The Shot Caller is the rising star of the underworld, with paths leading to Yard Boss or lateral moves into enforcement and killing.

careers.name: Skinwalker
careers.description: The Skinwalker is a shapeshifter who can assume the form of animals or other beings, drawing power from tribal traditions and the natural world. Evolving from Shamans, they possess a unique blend of physical and spiritual attributes, allowing them to adapt to any situation. Their skillset is focused on channeling shamanic energy, rituals, and melee combat, enabling them to fight in any form. They are also skilled in lore, persuasion, and psychology, allowing them to navigate both the human and animal worlds. The Skinwalker is a trickster and a guardian, a creature of myth and legend.

careers.name: Smuggler
careers.description: The Smuggler is a specialist in moving illicit goods across borders, avoiding detection by authorities and delivering cargo to its destination. Evolving from Carjackers, Drifters, Grifters, or Inmates, they possess enhanced Agility, Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, enabling them to plan routes, negotiate deals, and talk their way through checkpoints. Their skillset focuses on administration, psychology, streetwise, tactics, bribery, navigation, scanning, perception, and persuasion, providing the tools to outsmart customs and manage logistics. Their connections to the criminal underworld and transportation networks make them invaluable to the black market. The Smuggler is the artery of the underworld, with paths leading to arms dealing, fixing, or job coordination.

careers.name: Soldier
careers.description: The Soldier is a regular infantryman or conscript, serving in a formal military unit and learning the basics of warfare. With modest boosts to Strength, Endurance, and Willpower, they possess the physical and mental resilience needed for military service. Their skillset covers first aid, rifles, perception, survival, tactics, veteran experience, and basic honor, providing the foundation for a career in the armed forces. Their connections to military units anchor them in the chain of command. The Soldier is the basic building block of any army, with paths leading to commando, mercenary, SWAT, or survivalist roles.

careers.name: Street Samurai
careers.description: The Street Samurai is a cyber-enhanced warrior who serves corporations, gangs, or private clients, combining traditional martial arts with modern technology. Evolving from Razorboys, they possess enhanced Agility, Initiative, and Essence, reflecting their cybernetic augmentations and quick reflexes. Their skillset spans frame-building, athletics, intimidation, first aid, stealth, pistols, rifles, melee, perception, honor, and veteran experience, making them versatile combatants in the urban jungle. Their knowledge of the city and corporate connections give them access to high-paying gigs. The Street Samurai is the blade of the corporation, with paths leading to Blackguard, Operator, or Fukusho roles.

careers.name: Street Mage
careers.description: The Street Mage is a Hermetic magician who operates in the urban environment, blending arcane arts with street smarts to cast spells and manipulate reality. Evolving from Apprentices or Dabblers, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their deep magical knowledge and spiritual resilience. Their skillset centers on Hermetic channeling, focus, theft, perception, lore, persuasion, ritual, and streetwise, enabling them to perform rituals, acquire components, and navigate the underworld. Their connections to Hermetic, criminal, legal, and channeling communities give them a wide network. The Street Mage is a wizard of the concrete jungle, with paths leading to the Magician or Occultist.

careers.name: Surgeon
careers.description: The Surgeon is a medical virtuoso, a master of the operating room who can repair the most grievous injuries. Evolving from Doctors, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Willpower, allowing them to perform complex procedures with precision. Their skillset is focused on surgery, first aid, and treatment, enabling them to save lives and restore health. They are also skilled in perception and focus, allowing them to maintain concentration during delicate operations. The Surgeon is a guardian of life, wielding the scalpel with the grace of an artist.

careers.name: Survivalist
careers.description: The Survivalist is an expert in surviving in the wild, able to live off the land and endure the harshest conditions. Evolving from Soldiers, Rebels, or Survivors, they possess enhanced Endurance and Education, along with Strength, Agility, and Willpower, reflecting their physical toughness and mental resilience. Their skillset covers first aid, rifles, melee, perception, stealth, survival, mechanics, ordinance, and electrical, enabling them to build shelters, hunt, and defend themselves in remote areas. Their transportation connections help them move through the wilderness. The Survivalist is the ultimate self-reliant individual, with no further paths as they have mastered the art of staying alive.

careers.name: Survivor
careers.description: The Survivor is a hardened individual who has endured catastrophic events or lived on the fringes of society, relying on grit and luck to stay alive. With modest boosts across Strength, Agility, Endurance, Initiative, and Willpower, they possess the balanced resilience needed to face adversity. Their skillset covers athletics, intimidation, instinct, luck, pistols, rifles, melee, perception, and veteran experience, reflecting the practical skills of a wanderer in a hostile world. The Survivor is the starting point for those who choose to fight for their own survival, with paths leading to Survivalist, Tracker, Hunter, or Mercenary roles.

careers.name: Techy
careers.description: The Techy is a hands-on technician who learns the basics of electronics, mechanics, and computing through trial and error. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed for technical work. Their skillset introduces scanning, electrical, electronics, coding, cybernetics, mechanics, bypass, and system vulnerabilities, providing the core competencies of a tinkerer. Their connections to academic institutions and VTOL familiarity hint at specialized training. The Techy is the starting point for technical careers, with paths leading to Engineering or specialized roles.

careers.name: Terrorist
careers.description: The Terrorist is a radicalized operative who uses fear and violence as tools to achieve political or ideological ends. Evolving from Bombers or Commandos, they are masters of explosives, electronics, and asymmetric warfare. Their stats emphasize mental fortitude and physical agility, allowing them to execute complex attacks and evade capture. Their skillset is focused on ordnance, electrical engineering, and tactics, enabling them to create devastating devices and coordinate attacks. They are often driven by a strong will and charisma, able to inspire others to their cause. The Terrorist represents the dark side of revolutionary fervor, willing to sacrifice everything for their vision.

careers.name: Theoreticist
careers.description: The Theoreticist is a scientist who pushes the boundaries of knowledge, developing groundbreaking theories that reshape our understanding of the universe. Evolving from Scientists, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to conceive abstract concepts and solve complex problems. Their skillset is focused on admin, scanning, and focus, enabling them to conduct research and analyze data. They are also skilled in coding, allowing them to simulate theories and model outcomes. The Theoreticist is the mind behind the discovery, the thinker who sees the patterns others miss.

careers.name: Thug
careers.description: The Thug is a street-level enforcer who uses brute force and intimidation to settle disputes and collect debts. With modest boosts to Strength, Endurance, and Initiative, they possess the physical presence and quick reflexes needed for brawling. Their skillset covers first aid, melee, perception, intimidation, streetwise, pistols, and veteran experience, reflecting the simple but effective tactics of street violence. Their knowledge of the city and connections to criminal circles give them a foothold in the underworld. The Thug is the raw muscle of the criminal world, with paths leading to enforcement, sergeant-at-arms, made man, or killer roles.

careers.name: Tomb Raider
careers.description: The Tomb Raider is a daring explorer who seeks out ancient treasures and lost civilizations, braving the dangers of the past to uncover its secrets. Evolving from Archaeologists, they possess a unique blend of physical and intellectual attributes, allowing them to navigate treacherous ruins and decipher ancient codes. Their skillset is focused on scanning, perception, and lore, enabling them to find hidden chambers and identify valuable artifacts. They are also skilled in pistols, melee, and stealth, allowing them to defend themselves against traps and guardians. The Tomb Raider is a modern-day Indiana Jones, driven by the thrill of discovery.

careers.name: Tracker
careers.description: The Tracker is a skilled pursuer who can follow trails across any terrain, locating targets or game with uncanny accuracy. Evolving from Pups, Survivors, or Hunters, they possess enhanced Endurance and Education, along with Strength, Agility, and Willpower, reflecting their physical stamina and mental focus. Their skillset covers first aid, rifles, melee, perception, stealth, survival, shadowing, disguise, and navigation, enabling them to track, evade, and intercept targets. Their transportation connections and military contacts support their operations. The Tracker is the hound of the underworld, with paths leading to Ranger, Operator, or Blackguard roles.

careers.name: Trauma Tech
careers.summary: Emergency Medical Technician / Field Trauma Specialist
careers.description: The Trauma Tech is a specialized medical responder who provides immediate care in high-stress situations, stabilizing patients before transport. Evolving from Guides, Paramedics, or Mechanics, they possess enhanced Intelligence and Education, enabling them to diagnose and treat complex injuries. Their skillset focuses on administration, focus, first aid, perception, psychology, streetwise, and treatment, providing the tools to manage trauma cases in the field. Their knowledge of the city and language skills help them navigate emergency response systems. The Trauma Tech is the frontline of emergency medicine, with no further paths as they have reached the limit of their specialization.

careers.name: Union Agent
careers.description: The Union Agent is a fierce advocate for workers' rights, combining combat skills with bureaucratic expertise to protect laborers from corporate exploitation. Evolving from Detectives or Guards, they are skilled in negotiation, interrogation, and tactical combat. Their stats reflect a balance of physical strength and mental acuity, essential for navigating both the picket line and the boardroom. They are proficient in firearms, melee, and psychology, allowing them to defend their constituents effectively. Their administrative and bureaucracy skills enable them to organize strikes and negotiate contracts, making them a formidable force in the industrial landscape.

careers.name: Vadouan
careers.description: The Vadouan is a dedicated practitioner of Vodou, skilled in rituals, spirit communication, and community healing. Evolving from Hounsi, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Charisma, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their deep spiritual connection and social influence. Their skillset centers on lore, focus, intimidation, Vodou channeling, persuasion, ritual, streetwise, and perception, enabling them to lead ceremonies, guide the community, and navigate the complexities of the spirit world. Their connections to criminal, legal, and channeling communities give them a wide network. The Vadouan is a pillar of the Vodou faith, with no further paths as they have reached the height of their tradition.

careers.name: Wage Slave
careers.description: The Wage Slave is an entry-level corporate employee, performing routine tasks and learning the ropes of the business world. With modest boosts to Intelligence and Education, they possess the analytical foundation needed for office work. Their skillset includes administration, focus, persuasion, psychology, and coding, providing the basics of corporate productivity. Their connections to corporate circles give them a foothold in the business world. The Wage Slave is the starting point for corporate careers, with paths leading to Corpo or Businessman roles.

careers.name: Wage Mage
careers.description: The Wage Mage is a Hermetic magician who works for a corporation or wealthy patron, using their magical skills to solve problems and gain advantages. Evolving from Apprentices or Dabblers, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, and Essence, reflecting their magical training and spiritual resilience. Their skillset centers on administration, Hermetic channeling, focus, honor, lore, persuasion, ritual, and perception, enabling them to perform rituals, advise clients, and navigate the corporate world. Their connections to corporate, legal, and channeling communities give them a wide network. The Wage Mage is a mercenary of the arcane, with no further paths as they have reached the limit of their paid practice.

careers.name: Warden
careers.description: The Warden is a formidable keeper of order, responsible for managing high-security prisons or containing supernatural threats. Evolving from Hunters or Detectives, they possess a unique blend of combat, psychological, and ritualistic skills. Their stats emphasize physical strength and mental fortitude, allowing them to maintain control over dangerous inmates or entities. They are skilled in interrogation, stealth, and lore, enabling them to uncover secrets and prevent escapes. Their authority is absolute, backed by a deep understanding of human nature and the arcane. The Warden is a figure of immense responsibility, tasked with keeping the darkness at bay.

careers.name: Whistle Blower
careers.description: The Whistle Blower is a courageous insider who exposes corruption, fraud, or illegal activities within an organization. Evolving from Analysts, Journalists, or Drifters, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, Charisma, and Willpower, enabling them to gather evidence, withstand pressure, and speak truth to power. Their skillset includes administration, perception, psychology, stealth, bribery, coding, lore, shadowing, forgery, and disguise, providing the tools to uncover secrets, protect their identity, and leak information safely. They are the conscience of the corporation, with paths leading to field agency or infiltration roles.

careers.name: Wiccan
careers.description: The Wiccan is a beginner in the Wiccan tradition, learning to connect with nature, the elements, and the divine through ritual and observation. With modest boosts to Intelligence, Education, Willpower, and Essence, they possess the spiritual foundation needed for the path. Their skillset introduces Wiccan channeling, focus, ritual, lore, and persuasion, providing the basics of the craft. Their connections to Wiccan communities, proficiency in Latin, and historical knowledge of the faith ground them in their practice. The Wiccan is the first step on the pagan path, destined to grow into a Witch.

careers.name: Witch
careers.summary: Practitioner of the Craft / Hedge Wizard
careers.description: The Witch is a dedicated practitioner of Wicca, skilled in rituals, spellcasting, and herbalism. Evolving from Wiccans, they possess enhanced Intelligence, Education, Willpower, and Essence, reflecting their deepening magical connection and mental fortitude. Their skillset centers on administration, focus, intimidation, Wiccan channeling, perception, lore, persuasion, ritual, and streetwise, enabling them to perform ceremonies, protect themselves, and navigate both the spiritual and mundane worlds. Their connections to criminal, legal, and channeling communities give them a wide network. The Witch is a guardian of the old ways, with no further paths as they have reached the peak of their tradition.

careers.name: Yard Boss
careers.description: The Yard Boss is the ruler of the prison yard, commanding respect and fear from inmates and guards alike. Evolving from Shot Callers or Inmates, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Willpower, allowing them to maintain order in the chaotic environment of a prison. Their skillset is focused on intimidation, interrogation, and melee, enabling them to enforce their rules and crush dissent. They are also skilled in administration and bribery, allowing them to manage resources and negotiate with authorities. The Yard Boss is a king in chains, ruling his domain with an iron fist.
